description: Start a dated run of a checklist and return its RUN-YYYY-NNNN id. The steps are COPIED into the run, so editing the checklist afterwards never changes a run already under way. Runs are free and never capped.

checklist.description: The checklist id, e.g. CL-0001, or its name when only one carries it

date.description: The day the run happened, YYYY-MM-DD. Default today

reference.description: The job, order or asset id this run belongs to, e.g. WO-2026-0044. Named only; no sibling store is opened

title.description: What this run is against, e.g. Van BX21 KLM, February service

name: run_start
title: Start a run of a checklist
